category: DDL release index (Blu-ray and REMUX releases, host mirrors per post)

free_tier.stated: No account to read the index or the feed: /rss returned 300 items. A post page shows two mirror slots anonymously and prints '(login for more mirrors)'.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an index, not storage

retention.stated: Posts persist. The feed carries the 300 most recent items.

egress.terms: No byte allowance: HTML and XML only. Each post's mirrors point at external hosts; the href behind 'Link 1' did not appear in the extracted page, so the host behind it is unverified.

interface_detail: RSS 2.0 at /rss (content-type application/rss+xml, 300 items, self-link /rss.php), sitemap at /sitemap.xml. /feed/ returns 404. No JSON API found.
tooling: RSS reader. The item title carries release name and size ('Gebo.And.The.Shadow... - 23.7 GB'), so size filtering needs no post fetch.
chaining: Poll /rss, filter on size from the item title, then open the post for the two anonymous mirrors or log in for the rest.

limits.value: no published limit; 10 sequential /rss requests about 1.2 s apart and 8 concurrent requests all returned 200, and robots.txt is Allow: / for every agent

limits_note: Anonymous posts show 'Mirror 1: Link 1' and 'Mirror 2: Link 2' then '(login for more mirrors)'. The wider mirror set sits behind an account.
binding_note: As with any index, the only thing that can throttle a user is page rate; the wider mirror set is an identity gate recorded in identity_cost rather than one of the seven constraints.

identity_cost.detail: A login is what unlocks mirrors beyond the first two. The registration form was not opened, so whether it asks for email alone or email plus captcha was not established.

reliability_note: Cloudflare plus LiteSpeed. /feed/ 404s while /rss works, so a client that guesses the conventional WordPress path gets nothing.
confidence_note: Feed, post, robots.txt and both mirror slots were read on 2026-10-23. Registering and capturing the full mirror set would raise it to measured.

evidence.proved: content-type application/rss+xml, 300 items, titles that carry the size, self-link https://ddlbase.com/rss.php
'Mirror 1: Link 1', 'Mirror 2: Link 2', '(login for more mirrors)', MediaInfo block and 23.67 GiB filesize
robots.txt allows every crawler on every path ('Allow: /') and names the sitemap https://ddlbase.com/sitemap.xml
a GET of https://ddlbase.com/robots.txt answered HTTP 200 with 128 bytes of text/plain on 2026-10-30

notes: The deepest free feed measured at 300 items, and the only one that puts the size in the item title. The caveat is the mirror cap: two anonymous links per post. ddlbase.net answers as a separate XenForo forum and is not the same index.
